scope: sandbox, tool execution, workspace isolation, filesystem, process execution, shell, git, build, test, resource limits, docker, network isolation, path traversal, symlinks, secrets, artifacts, tool results, cancellation, agent-runtime integration

applicable.title: Checkpoint validation must succeed from a detached checkout of the checkpoint tag
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Validate the checkpoint from a clean clone detached at its own tag, not only on the branch.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A recorded validate_checkpoint.py run from a detached checkout returning CHECKPOINT_VALID.

applicable.title: A file inventory must be recomputed from the repository, never trusted as an assertion
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Declare every changed path with a reason before finalizing and let the tooling bind the hashes.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A FILES.json whose declared change set matches the recomputed one, proven by a passing validation.

applicable.title: Every operation attempt must be auditable, including a refusal decided before execution
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that a refused operation appends its attempt to the ledger before returning an error.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A ledger record with result PRECONDITION_REJECTED, a result code and a failure reason.

applicable.title: A checkpoint may never claim readiness while it also claims to be blocked
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Verify that the checkpoint carries no blocker while it claims to be ready for review.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing validation with blockedBy empty at a readiness status.

applicable.title: A PASS requires evidence that can be executed or resolved, not a statement
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Attach a resolvable evidence reference to every PASS recorded by this Gate.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run confirming that every PASS reference resolves.

applicable.title: The repository must be self-contained; a specification may not live outside it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every specification this Gate depends on is committed to the repository.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing documentation link and checklist test.

applicable.title: Independent validation cannot be declared by the run that did the work
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Close the implementing run at an internal status and leave the independent verdict pending.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A checkpoint whose independentReview and redTeam are PENDING at handoff.

applicable.title: Requirement completeness must be total and evidence-backed before handoff
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Extract every requirement before implementing and audit completeness before handoff.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A completeness report with total coverage and total evidence coverage.

applicable.title: A red gate requires rework, never a waiver, and never a weakened check
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Run the Green Keeper until every mandatory gate is green, repairing causes rather than checks.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A rework log whose last cycle is GREEN with zero remaining failures.

applicable.title: A recorded command must carry runtime, working directory, commit and purpose to be replayable
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Record commands with the tooling so each one is executable from its declared working directory.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run over a ledger whose commands all resolve.

applicable.title: A control over a checkpoint's own evidence must be scoped to the moment it matters
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Check whether any new control would be invalidated by the evidence its own run produces.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing validation executed by the gate harness itself.

applicable.title: Sealed checkpoints and their tags are immutable, and tooling must keep validating them
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category git; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every sealed checkpoint still validates under the tooling this Gate changes.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A passing historical compatibility run over every sealed tag.

applicable.title: An installed capability must be detected by resolved path, not by a bare command lookup
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category environment; severity MEDIUM; status CONFIRMED, so it is not yet prevented automatically
applicable.requiredCheck: When this Gate records a capability, resolve the executable path before concluding anything about availability.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A capability record naming the resolved path, or a justification that this Gate detects no capability.

applicable.title: Evidence must be recorded as it happens, not reconstructed at the end of a run
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Record each command through the tooling while the work happens.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A ledger whose records were produced by the recording tooling during the run.

applicable.title: Every positive terminal status needs one shared promotion invariant
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every positive terminal status this Gate can produce is covered by the shared promotion invariant, not only the status this delivery ends at.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A table-driven validation run that exercises every positive status against every mandatory red dimension.

applicable.title: A mandatory set must be closed by policy, never chosen by the caller
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every control whose scope could be narrowed by an argument derives that scope from policy instead.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A recorded gate run whose requiredGates equal the canonical mandatory set, with a successful command for each one.

applicable.title: A completeness denominator must come from a source the delivery does not own
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that the expected requirement set is derived independently and compared as a set, not only as a count.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A completeness report whose expected and declared identifier sets are equal.

applicable.title: A structured reference must be resolved, not merely well typed
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every reference this Gate records is resolved by a tool, not accepted as a string.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a nonexistent control, a nonexistent evidence path and a nested secret.

applicable.title: A derived artifact must carry a fingerprint of the inputs that produced it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every derived artifact this Gate stores can be recomputed and is recomputed during validation.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a preflight whose inputs have changed.

applicable.title: Evidence produced from a dirty tree needs immutable input identity
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every recorded command binds its inputs by content and that no timestamp in the ledger is later than the recorded end of the run.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run over a ledger whose records all carry an input digest, with a post-commit validation record at the sealed commit.

applicable.title: Sealed history needs an anchor outside the content it describes
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category git; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that the integrity chain still resolves for every sealed checkpoint and that this Gate anchors every sealed predecessor.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A verification run over the anchor chain returning no divergence.

applicable.title: An authoritative count must be derived once, never maintained by hand twice
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every count used as evidence in this Gate is derived from one source and verified where it is quoted.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a report whose stated count contradicts the derived one.

applicable.title: A lesson must cite a source that actually records the finding it claims
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every lesson this Gate writes or updates cites a checkpoint that records the finding identifier it names.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A memory validation run that resolves every lesson source locator.

applicable.title: A control is finished only when its positive path has been executed, not only its refusals
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every control this Gate adds or changes that gates a status, execute the path that reaches the status, not only the paths that are refused.
applicable.requiredEvidence: An executed positive-path test or simulation artifact for each such control.

applicable.title: A generic guardrail derives repository state instead of naming today's checkpoint
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that no generic guard, test or policy in this Gate names a historical checkpoint to decide behaviour, and that any such rule is derived from repository state.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A derived exclusion with a test proving it moves, or a documented fixture that names a concrete checkpoint on purpose.

applicable.title: An adversarial battery without a null-mutation control proves nothing
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Run every adversarial battery of this Gate with an unmutated control through the same path, and record its result with the battery.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A Red Team report whose baselineControl is VALID.

applicable.title: A lesson's prose may record a residual limit but may never contradict its status
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category documentation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every lesson this Gate writes or updates describes limits rather than restating its own status.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A memory validation run with no status contradiction reported.

applicable.title: A configuration key that no code reads is a defect, not documentation
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every configuration key this Gate declares is read by the implementation, or remove it and document the fixed behaviour.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validated policy document whose every key has a consumer.

applicable.title: A required protocol transition must never turn a mandatory gate red
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category process; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Before handoff, execute the protocol transitions this Gate's successor will perform and confirm the mandatory gates stay green.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A successor durability artifact whose every state is green.

applicable.title: An empty applicable set is not a missing required set, and a control must tell them apart
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every quality or audit control this Gate adds or changes that operates on a derived set, confirm that an empty applicable set is reported as NOT_APPLICABLE with a justification and that a missing required set is reported as a failure.
applicable.requiredEvidence: An executed artifact showing both outcomes: a passing run whose empty dimensions are justified, and a failing run whose named items are unsatisfied.

applicable.title: A control written while one Gate was the only Gate stops being a control when the next one starts
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every control this Gate adds or changes, confirm that what it judges is derived from a canonical source rather than written into the control, and that it would still be correct for the Gate after this one.
applicable.requiredEvidence: An executed transition into the next Gate, and a test that the control's subject comes from a registry rather than a literal.

applicable.title: A value bound in middleware is absent in the handlers that run outside it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every cross-cutting value this Gate binds in middleware, confirm it is present in the responses produced above that middleware, including error responses.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A test that triggers a failure handled outside the middleware chain and asserts the value is still carried.

applicable.title: Re-deriving what the framework already computed diverges from the framework
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Where this Gate derives a value the framework already computes, confirm it reads the framework's result rather than recomputing it, and that a test asserts the value rather than only its presence.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A test asserting the specific derived value, not merely that the endpoint answers.

applicable.title: Captured subprocess output decoded or re-emitted with the platform codepage crashes the tool, not the work
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm every subprocess capture this Gate adds states its decoder explicitly, that every entry point re-emitting captured output configures its own stream, and that the repository-wide control still passes.
applicable.requiredEvidence: The control-plane test that parses the tree, green, with the rule exercised against a rejecting case.

applicable.title: A gate that runs inside an image measures the image, not the source
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every mandatory gate this Gate adds or changes, confirm that a gate executing inside a built artefact rebuilds that artefact before measuring, and that the repository-wide control still passes.
applicable.requiredEvidence: The control-plane test that parses every gate module, green, with the rule exercised against a rejecting case.

applicable.title: A shared control that names an identifier the repository derives stops being a control when that identifier moves
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category tooling; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every control this Gate adds which reasons about an identifier the repository derives -- the current Gate, the newest checkpoint, the head migration -- derives it rather than naming it, and that the repository-wide control still passes.
applicable.requiredEvidence: The control-plane test that parses every caller, green, with a rejecting case.

applicable.title: Two representations of one concept in one module disagree, and the safer one loses
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Where this Gate defines a classification twice — once anchored and once embedded — confirm one definition is authoritative and the other derives from it or is removed.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A test asserting both paths classify the same corpus identically.

applicable.title: A test that writes to the operational database leaves production data behind
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every test this Gate adds that writes to a shared service rather than to a disposable one, confirm it removes what it created and that an invariant detects residue.
applicable.requiredEvidence: The suite run followed by a query of the shared service showing no fixture rows.

applicable.title: A control that judges sealed history only runs once a successor anchors it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every sealed predecessor this Gate anchors validates from a detached checkout of its own tag, and that no command this Gate records declares an input the repository does not carry.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A validation run against each anchored checkpoint from its tag, green.

applicable.title: An editing path that consumes a backslash escape leaves a control character, and the control it belonged to silently matches nothing
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every scan this Gate adds asserts it found something before judging it, and that no source file carries a stray control character.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A green run of the repository-wide control-character scan and of each scan's own non-empty-corpus assertion.

applicable.title: A naming convention rewrites a CHECK constraint's name and leaves a UNIQUE constraint's alone
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every migration this Gate adds, confirm it is applied and reversed against a disposable database, and that autogenerate finds nothing left to do afterwards.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A green reversibility run and a green autogenerate check against a database migrated from zero.

applicable.title: A log line is not evidence that another process is ready
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every wait this Gate adds on another process, confirm it asks that process or its server for the state rather than reading a log line.
applicable.requiredEvidence: The readiness path asserted against the server's own answer, with the log-line path refused by a test.

applicable.title: A boundary scan must read the code rather than the prose, and must be shown to fire on a mutated module
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category quality; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every boundary scan this Gate adds, confirm it reads the syntax tree rather than the text, and that it carries a control which runs the identical scan over a module that violates the rule.
applicable.requiredEvidence: Each scan's null control executed and green, alongside the scan itself.

applicable.title: A counted test suite must declare its cases statically, because the denominator is read from the source
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Confirm that every case this Gate adds to a counted suite is declared statically, with table-driven inputs written as a loop rather than as a parametrisation.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A green run of the counted-suite scan alongside the suite itself.

applicable.title: A timeout that cancels the task it runs in leaves nothing able to record what happened
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity CRITICAL; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every limit this Gate enforces, confirm that the enforcement path is still able to write when it fires, and that a real run is observed reaching the terminal state with the reason recorded.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A recorded scenario run in which the limit fires and the store shows the terminal state, the error type and the event.

applicable.title: A refusal that misnames the defect spends the only repair on the wrong correction
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every validator whose refusal is sent back as the instruction to correct - to a model through a repair, or to a user - confirm that each distinct defect (absent, wrong type, wrong value) has its own reason, and that a wrong-typed value is never reported as missing.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A test per defect class asserting the reason code and that the sentence names the defect it found.

applicable.title: A state and the event that explains it, written in two commits, are written event first
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Wherever a state and the record that explains it are written in separate commits, confirm which one a reader between the two can see alone, and that it is the one a reader may act on - the record before the state it explains.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A test that observes what the log held at the moment each terminal state was written.

applicable.title: A metric read the instant after the call that moved it is read before the scrape that carries it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category testing; severity MEDIUM; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every check that reads what another process observes on its own cycle - a scrape, a poll, a flush - confirm that the check waits for at least one full cycle, with a bound, and never repeats the action it is observing to make the observation appear.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A test in which the observation arrives only after a delay, and the check still passes within its bound.

applicable.title: A checkpoint sealed without naming its own tag cannot be validated from that tag
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category checkpoint; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: Before sealing a checkpoint at any status, confirm that STATE.json currentCommit names the checkpoint's own canonical tag, and that the sealed content validates from that tag with a detached HEAD.
applicable.requiredEvidence: The post-seal validation from the checkpoint's own tag, and the seal tool's refusal of a state that does not name it.

applicable.title: A payload one service bounds for another must be bounded as the receiver measures it
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category implementation; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every payload one service bounds and another service accepts or refuses by size, confirm both measure it the same way and that the receiver's bound is not smaller than what the sender may hand over.
applicable.requiredEvidence: A test that reads both bounds from their sources and compares them, and a test that the sender's bound holds for the worst-case rendering.

applicable.title: Two processes that meet on a queue must name what crosses it once, and a real run must exercise both
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category architecture; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every payload this Gate sends between two processes, confirm its names are defined once in a shared contract, used by both sides, and exercised once by a run in which neither side is a double.
applicable.requiredEvidence: The shared definition, a scan of both sides for a literal spelling, and a recorded run through the real producer and consumer.

applicable.title: A process sweep that reads what a forking process holds waits on the processes it has to kill
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category security; severity HIGH; already guarded, so the control must keep holding
applicable.requiredCheck: For every control that must end processes it did not start, confirm it freezes before it kills, reads nothing a forking process holds, and is attacked on the real engine by a process that detaches and forks.
applicable.requiredEvidence: An engine test in which a detached fork bomb is swept and the next command still runs.

applicable.title: A pre-push check narrower than the change's reach lets a red gate reach the public remote
applicable.reasonApplicable: applies to every Gate; category git; severity MEDIUM; status CONFIRMED, so it is not yet prevented automatically
applicable.requiredCheck: Before each push, run the lint gate and the repository-wide scans as well as the suites of the change, because a change reaches every control that scans the tree.
applicable.requiredEvidence: Recorded lint and targeted runs between each push and the one before it.

derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: A green run of the counted-suite scan alongside the suite itself.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a timeout that cancels the task it runs in leaves nothing able to record what happened
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: A recorded scenario run in which the limit fires and the store shows the terminal state, the error type and the event.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a refusal that misnames the defect spends the only repair on the wrong correction
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: A test per defect class asserting the reason code and that the sentence names the defect it found.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a state and the event that explains it, written in two commits, are written event first
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: A test that observes what the log held at the moment each terminal state was written.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a metric read the instant after the call that moved it is read before the scrape that carries it
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: A test in which the observation arrives only after a delay, and the check still passes within its bound.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a checkpoint sealed without naming its own tag cannot be validated from that tag
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: The post-seal validation from the checkpoint's own tag, and the seal tool's refusal of a state that does not name it.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a payload one service bounds for another must be bounded as the receiver measures it
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: A test that reads both bounds from their sources and compares them, and a test that the sender's bound holds for the worst-case rendering.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify two processes that meet on a queue must name what crosses it once, and a real run must exercise both
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: The shared definition, a scan of both sides for a literal spelling, and a recorded run through the real producer and consumer.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a process sweep that reads what a forking process holds waits on the processes it has to kill
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: An engine test in which a detached fork bomb is swept and the next command still runs.

derivedRequirements.description: Verify a pre-push check narrower than the change's reach lets a red gate reach the public remote
derivedRequirements.requiredEvidence: Recorded lint and targeted runs between each push and the one before it.
